entities.name: PMID:27514407
observations: Pattison et al., Mol Cancer Res. 2016;14(11):1078-1086. PMID 27514407. Describes KLF5 binding and a polymorphic CCNE1 intronic enhancer in bladder cancer risk.

entities.name: KLF5
observations: Chromatin immunoprecipitation showed KLF5 binds a novel enhancer in the first intron of CCNE1; a linked polymorphism alters binding.

entities.name: CCNE1
observations: In bladder cancer cell lines heterozygous for rs8102137, CCNE1 transcription was 1.5-fold higher from the risk allele; reporter and CRISPR-Cas9 experiments characterized the intronic regulatory element.

entities.name: rs8102137
observations: Bladder cancer GWAS risk SNP located approximately 6 kb upstream of CCNE1; heterozygous bladder cancer cells showed 1.5-fold greater CCNE1 transcription from its risk allele.

entities.name: rs200996365
observations: SNP in high linkage disequilibrium with rs8102137, located centrally in a KLF5 motif; its presence alters KLF5 binding at the CCNE1 intronic enhancer.

entities.name: KLF5-CCNE1 enhancer risk
observations: A 2016 study supports a functional mechanism in which a polymorphic KLF5 motif in a CCNE1 intronic enhancer alters KLF5 binding and CCNE1 transcription; this offers mechanistic support for bladder-cancer susceptibility associated with rs8102137, but does not alone prove population-level causation.
